Author: Kathy Auteberry (fork of AnoMech by Anomek)
Name: FluffySim
Description: Practice FFXIV Ultimate mechanics inside the game, solo with seven simulated party members or together in multiplayer. Covers Dragonsong's Reprise (Elemental) and Futures Rewritten (Mana), plus The Epic of Alexander (Mana), The Omega Protocol P1–P3 (Elemental) and Dancing Mad (Mana) in beta, with God Mode, Pause and Restart for repeated attempts. Based on AnoMech by Anomek and contributors.
Punchline: Ultimate practice for DSR, FRU, TEA, TOP and Dancing Mad, solo or multiplayer.
Changelog:
Changed
- Catgirl party: Solo bots and every multiplayer seat now appear as female Miqo'te, each with a distinct look, instead of Lalafell.

Fixed
- Local markers in multiplayer: Every player now sees the markers the host's run places, including the Dancing Mad Forsaken self-marks.
- Apocalypse overlay in multiplayer: The local light and trail overlay in FRU P3 Apocalypse now works for every player, not just the host.

Author: Kathy Auteberry (fork of EchoXIV by ssalazar217)
Name: Kotodama
Description:
Kotodama is a personal fork of EchoXIV focused on fast, accurate Japanese<->English chat translation for Japanese PF raiding and everyday social chat, powered by a local LLM.

Based on EchoXIV by ssalazar217: https://github.com/ssalazar217/EchoXIV
Punchline: Japanese<->English chat translation with a local LLM. Fork of EchoXIV.
Changelog:
Incoming messages
- Lines you type yourself (without /tl) are never translated, so a Japanese line of your own no longer gets a [KT] translation.
- Your own lines in party chat are now recognised too (the party number in front of your name used to hide them).
